model_output:
```sql
WITH viewpoint_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    poi_name,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-123.962654, 45.855581), 4326)::geography AS geom
  FROM (VALUES (2364, 'Silver Point Interpretive Overlook')) AS tmp(id, poi_name)
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM viewpoint_geom))
),
clipped_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(slope_rast, (SELECT geom::geometry FROM viewpoint_geom), true) AS clipped_rast
  FROM slope_raster
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT poi_name FROM viewpoint_geom) AS poi_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1, 1) > 30 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS is_steeper_than_30_degrees
FROM clipped_slope;
```
